fields.label: Income/franchise tax nexus
fields.value: New Hampshire determines nexus based on constitutional due process minimum connection standards without bright-line factor-presence thresholds. For both 2025 and 2026, filing thresholds require gross business income everywhere exceeding $109,000 for the Business Profits Tax, or gross business receipts or enterprise value tax base exceeding $298,000 for the Business Enterprise Tax.
fields.source_citation: NH Department of Revenue Administration Shares 2026 Tax Tips and Filing Guidance
fields.quote: The filing threshold for the Business Enterprise Tax (BET) was increased to gross business receipts over $298,000, or an enterprise value tax base over $298,000.

fields.label: Individual income tax
fields.value: New Hampshire does not impose a general individual income tax on earned wages, and the Interest and Dividends Tax was repealed effective January 1, 2025.

fields.label: Corporate income/franchise tax
fields.value: New Hampshire imposes a Business Profits Tax at a rate of 7.5% on taxable business profits for businesses with gross business income exceeding $109,000. No statutory minimum tax is imposed.
fields.source_citation: Business Taxes | NH Department of Revenue Administration
fields.quote: The tax rate is 7.6% for taxable periods ending on or after December 31, 2022, and 7.5% for taxable periods ending on or after December 31, 2023.

fields.label: Individual due date and extension
fields.value: New Hampshire does not impose a general personal income tax, and the Interest and Dividends Tax was repealed effective for taxable periods beginning on or after January 1, 2025. Consequently, calendar-year individuals have no state return filing requirement or extension procedure for tax years 2025 and 2026.

fields.label: Key forms
fields.value: Primary business returns include Form NH-1120 for corporations, Form NH-1065 for partnerships, and Form NH-1040 for sole proprietorships, all submitted with transmittal Form BT-Summary. Form DP-10 for individuals is discontinued beginning with tax year 2025.
